plotEn:
On 12 November 2023, Gino Cecchettin, a recently widowed software developer in Vigonovo, becomes concerned about his middle daughter, Giulia, after she fails to return home from an outing the evening before. After learning that she had been with her ex boyfriend, Gino calls the police and, with help from the Penelope Italia volunteer group, the Cecchettins post online appeals reaching out to people who may have seen the couple. One of the appeals is answered by a man who witnessed a girl matching Giulia's description being beaten and dragged into a car only 150 metres away from the Cecchettin household.
Gino's eldest daughter, Elena, questions the ex-boyfriend's friend group, and learns that he was controlling to the point of wanting Giulia to postpone her graduation so that it coincided with his own, and that he expressed suicidal thoughts after she had left him. A week after her disappearance, Giulia is found murdered in Barcis, while her ex boyfriend is arrested while fleeing in Germany.
Elena is disgusted by the media coverage of her sister's murder, perceiving it as blaming Giulia for her own death. She makes a live statement, during which she denounces the media for labeling the ex boyfriend a "monster", arguing instead that her sister's murderer is a natural product of the patriarchy and rape culture.
